answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A raven of per-task receipts records who did what, and the meadow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors. Written in a bullet-like short clauses, then a summary line register, it stays short. The saffron of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
